nodes.label: Admin-Only Account Provisioning
nodes.rationale: Disables public self sign-up (enable_signup = false); accounts are created only by server-side service-role provisioning with profile and org assignment.

nodes.label: Three-Layer Account Deactivation
nodes.rationale: Cuts off access at Auth (banning user), Database (RLS helper functions is_admin() and my_org_unit_ids() filter is_active=true, D9/0010), and Data Access Layer.

nodes.label: Corporate ESG Approval Route
nodes.rationale: Resolves route conflicts by giving Corporate ESG /app/approvals while keeping /admin strictly Admin-only.

nodes.label: NIST SP 800-63B Password Baseline
nodes.rationale: Initial policy requiring 12 minimum characters with no composition rules based on NIST SP 800-63B (subsequently superseded by owner request).

nodes.label: Direct Postgres Transactions via postgres.js
nodes.rationale: Uses postgres.js direct connection via DATABASE_URL to execute atomic multi-table mutations and audit writes in TypeScript transactions.

nodes.label: First-Admin Provisioning Script
nodes.rationale: apps/web/scripts/provision-user.ts provisions initial Admin account via service role with First-Admin guard preventing duplicate admin creation.
